definitions.full: H7393. rekeb רֶ֫כֶב noun masculine 2Kin 13:7 [even Nahum 2:5 , where read מַרְאֵיהֶם (for הֶן -) We Now Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 90 ] chariotry, chariot, mill-stone ; apparently also riders (compare Lag BN 151 ); — absolute ׳ר Gen 50:9 +, רָ֑כֶב 2Sam 8:4 +; construct דֶכֶב Exod 14:9 +; suffix דִכְבִּי Judg 4:7 +, רִכְבּוֺ 2Kin 5:9 +, דִכְבָּהּ Nahum 2:14; plural construct רִכְבֵי Song 1:9 ; — Hosea 10:13 see below; — 1 109 collective chariotry, chariots [sometimes of specific no. 2Kin 13:7 ; 2Sam 8:4 ; Exod 14:7 etc.; often + מָּרָשִׁים , ( ים ) סוּס ], especially war-chariots : in Egypt 14:7 (J), Josh 24:6 (E) +; early Canaan 11:4 ; Judg 4:7 , 13 ; 5:28 (not singular; || מַרְכְּבוֺתָיו ) +, called ׳ר כַּרְוֶל (i.e. iron-bound, or studded, compare GFM 1:2 19 and references ), Josh 17:16 , 18 ; Judg 1:19 ; 4:3 , 13 ; Philistine, according to 1Sam 13:5 ; 2Sam 1:6 ; Aram 8:4 ; 10:18 +; Judah and Israel (from David's time, compare 8:4 ) 1Kin 9:19 , 22 ; 10:26 +, read also בְּרִכְבְּךָ Hosea 10:13 (for בְּדַרְכְּךָ ) ᵐ5 B We Now GASm; Assyria 2Kin 19:23 = Isa 37:24 ; Nahum 2:4 ; 2:5 ; Nahum 2:14 (to be burnt; made mainly of wood); Babylon Jer 47:3 (on title 47:1 , see Gf Gie), 50:37 ; 51:21 ; Ezek 23:24 +, etc.; for dignity and display 1Kin 1:5 ; 2Kin 5:9 ; Jer 17:25 ; 22:4 ; Isa 66:20 , compare Gen 50:9 (J), (compare also 1Kin 9:19 , 22 ; 10:26 , etc.); figurative of Elijah, ׳ר וּפָרָשׁיו יִשְׂרָאֵל 2Kin 2:12 , of elisha 13:14 ; אֵשׁ רֶכֶב 2:11 chariotry of fire (at Elijah's translation); ׳ר אֵל Psa 68:18 chariots of El , i.e. his heavenly host, compare vision 2Kin 6:17 , and also 7:6 ; ׳ר meton, for chariot- horses 2Sam 8:4 = 1Chr 18:4 . 2 of single chariot 1Kin 22:35 , 38 ; 2Kin 9:21 (twice in verse); 9:24 ; 10:16 ; 2Chr 35:24 , probably also Exod 14:6 ; plural פַרְעֹה רִכְבֵי Song 1:9 . 3 upper millstone (as riding on the lower) Deut 24:6 ; Judg 9:53 ; 2Sam 11:21 . 4 apparently = riders (collective), troop (of riders): סוּסִים רֶכֶב שְׁנֵי 2Kin 7:14 **read perhaps רֹכְבֵי , compare ᵐ5 and 9:16 Bur.; two riders of horses, horsemen (ro two chariots drawn by horses ? ); in following text dubious: ׳ד ר פָרָשִׁים ׳צֶמֶד ר ׳חֲמוֺר גָּמֶל Isa 21:7 riders , namely a pair of horsemen, ass-riders, camel-rides ; compare ׳ר מָּרָשִׁים צֶמֶד אִישׁ 21:9 i.e. men riding, a pair of horsemen ; ׳בְּד מָּרָשִׁים אָדָם 22:6 with riders (consisting of) men, horsemen , but use of אָדָם very improbable; attractive is with chariotry of (drawn by) steeds ( ׳א as gloss) Du Che Hpt Di-Kit but ׳פ hardly steeds here (compare ׳פ horsemen , 22:7 ); read perhaps simply ׳בְּר ׳וּפ .
